topics.topic: NITI Aayog Report: Achieving Efficiencies in MSME Sector through Convergence of Schemes
topics.why_in_news: NITI Aayog released a roadmap to improve MSME sector efficiency through convergence of schemes, digital integration and coordinated governance mechanisms.
prelims_quick_notes: MSMEs important for employment, exports and industrial growth.
Report emphasises convergence of overlapping MSME schemes.
Focus on reducing compliance burden and transaction costs.
Convergence includes credit, skilling, marketing and innovation schemes.
Cluster-based development and market linkage prioritised.
Whole-of-government approach emphasised for MSME ecosystem.
important_facts: NITI Aayog is policy think tank of Government of India.
MSME Ministry administers multiple schemes across sectors.
SFURTI scheme supports traditional industries and clusters.
MSE-CDP stands for Micro and Small Enterprises Cluster Development Programme.
ASPIRE focuses on agro-rural entrepreneurship and incubation.
PM Vishwakarma supports traditional artisans and craftspeople.
key_highlights: AI-based centralised MSME digital portal proposed.
Integration of Centre and State data systems recommended.
Convergence of skill-development and cluster schemes suggested.
Innovation and incubation ecosystem integration emphasised.
Targeted schemes for SC/ST, NER and artisans retained separately.
exam_relevance: Important for Governance, Economy and MSME sector reforms.
Useful for Digital Governance and Ease of Doing Business topics.
Can be linked with employment generation and cooperative federalism.
prelims_traps: NITI Aayog is not a constitutional body.
MSMEs contribute significantly to exports and employment.
PMEGP and PM Vishwakarma remain independent schemes.
